tips: Start each reel with a bold, benefit‑driven hook like “Apka Business 3x zyada grow karega!” especially in Urdu and Arabic where engagement is highest
Showcase quick success snippets for mobile‑phone shops, bakeries, cafes and jewellery – the top‑performing business types
Use Arabic and Urdu captions for reels; keep English for long videos but add subtitles to boost reach
Title style: action‑oriented and localized, e.g., “Web Builder ke saath apni dukaan ko upgrade karein”
